children: Bitcoin rises in early Asian trading after hitting a six-week low recently. The cryptocurrency has fallen below the $80,000 level partly due to a hawkish Federal Reserve outlook and Binance's recent security breach, StoneX's Michael Boutros says in a commentary. Treasury yields, the dollar's strength and bitcoin ETF flows are among key drivers of market sentiment in November, the senior technical strategist adds. Bitcoin is 0.9% higher at $78,503.18.(amanda.lee@wsj.com)
